description: Completes the My Family module, as the Complete button of the app does. Call it only when the customer says that the list of family members is complete. First call list_family_members, and show the customer the full list of family members. Then show this exact statement, and get an explicit yes: "I have shared a complete version of my family members." Then call with confirm true. The completion can open the next module. Give the customer next_step.

confirm.description: True only after the customer said yes to the statement of the description.

expected_module_state.description: The module_state that you read from the list or describe tool of this module, also when it is open. When the state is now different, the tool saves nothing and gives the new state.

name: complete_my_family

completed_now.description: False when the module was already complete. The tool then changed nothing.

next_step.description: The current module of the customer.

waiting_for_partner.description: Why the next module waits for the partner.

title: Complete My Family
